description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, an Android activity that displays detailed information about a TV program or channel. It handles UI initialization, content population from intent extras, focus management for Android TV remote navigation, button interactions, and an integrated network request to initiate video playback via an API. The activity layout includes visual components such as background images, text views for program info, and focusable action buttons, with focus animations and input handling.
external_files: R (resources, including layout and drawable resources)

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed information about a TV program, manages focus and user interactions, and initiates video playback through an API call.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, populates content data, and sets up action buttons.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets the current system date and time in designated TextViews.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates UI components with data received via intent extras, or defaults.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons, sets icons, labels, focus, and click listeners.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates visual feedback when a button gains or loses focus.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Handles click events for action buttons, including a scale animation.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote control key events for navigation and selection.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Makes an API POST request to /api/play with a sample video URL, handles response, and starts the video player activity.

methods.name: extractUrlFromResponse
methods.description: Parses the server response to extract a URL string to play.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Static factory method to create an Intent to launch ContentInfoActivity with detailed content meta-data.
